arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ فِي طَلَبِ السَّتْرِ وَ الْوِقَايَةِ
english_title: 41. His Supplication in Asking for Covering and Protection

phrases.english: 1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
2.spread for me the bed of Your honour,
3.bring me to the wateringholes of Your mercy,
4.set me down in the midst of Your Garden,
5.stamp me not with rejection by You,
6.deprive me not through disappointment by You,
7.settle not accounts with me for what I have committed,
8.make no reckoning with me for what I have earned,

phrases.arabic: وَلا تُـبْرِزْ مَكْتُوْمِي، وَلاَ تَكْشِفْ مَسْتُورِي،
phrases.english: 9.display not what I have hidden, expose not what I have covered over,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَى مِيزانِ الأنْصَافِ عَمَلِي،
phrases.english: 10.weigh not my works on the scales of fairness,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تُعْلِنْ عَلَى عُيُونِ الْمَلاَءِ خَبَـرِي.
phrases.english: 11.and make not my tidings known to the eyes of the crowd!

phrases.arabic: أَخْفِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يَكُونُ نَشْرُهُ عَلَيَّ عَاراً،
phrases.english: 12.Conceal from them everything whose unfolding would shame me

phrases.arabic: وَاطْوِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يُلْحِقُنِي عِنْدَكَ شَنَاراً،
phrases.english: 13.and roll up before them all which would join me to disgrace with You!
14.Ennoble my degree through Your good pleasure,
15.perfect my honour through Your forgiveness,
16.rank me among the companions of the right hand,
17.direct me to the roads of the secure,
18.place me in the throng of the triumphant,
19.and through me let the sessions of the righteous thrive!
20.Amen, Lord of the worlds!
